notes: «أن يزيد بن زريع، ويحيى بن سعيد، حدثاهم قالا» : the two are one level, and they are the source Musaddad gets the report from (rules 2 and 5).
«زاد في حديث يحيى» and «والإخبار في حديث يزيد» are wording remarks with no new name: left out.
Abu Musa's words carry the Prophet's saying, so he is the last link.
